question: Should I approve the $284K Staff SWE band exception?

intro.title: Meet Maya Chen
intro.text: HR Business Partner, People & Culture, Singapore. 2,412 employees, 18 pending PTO requests, one $284,000 offer decision — all before 15:00 today.

hero.title: A day made of people
hero.text: No task list — faces. Tomas Rivera's $284K ask leads under a live countdown to 15:00; eight more chips wait, and eNPS faces smile or frown per team.

kpis.title: Four numbers, no chrome
kpis.text: A naked strip: headcount 2,412, attrition 11.4% down 0.8 points, offer acceptance 87.5%, time-to-fill 38 days — live from Workday and Greenhouse.

chart.title: The signal no system sees
chart.text: One full-bleed join: Workday, Slack, Greenhouse overlaid. Slack engagement fell 24% since May while attrition hit 11.4% — flagging a Q1 FY27 rebound risk.

ask.title: Drag Tomas into chat
ask.text: Maya drags the decision card straight into chat. askMElah checks the L6 band, the $295K competing offer, the CFO note — and recommends approving $284,000.

delegate.title: Working for her people
delegate.text: Each delegation is tagged with who it serves. For Priya: the Deloitte letter chased — she signed within 2 hours; only James Whitfield's counter-signature remains.

crew.title: Meet the Crew
crew.text: Delegating opens a tiny office of agents. Maya's mascot Mei carries the Deloitte task to askMElah, hands it to Clause in Legal and Bolt in Sales, then walks the result back to her desk.

autopilot.title: Autopilot unblocks people
autopilot.text: In People waiting, approvals are faces, not forms. Flip Autopilot and low-risk asks clear — Wei Lin Tan's Greenhouse access granted, and she's notified instantly.

mcp.title: Wired into eight systems
mcp.text: The quiet footer: Workday, Greenhouse, DocuSign and five more live connections. That's why every recommendation arrives with real numbers already attached.

recap.title: The pulse of her week
recap.text: Chapter 04 tallies it: 16.5 meeting hours, 11 focus hours, $9,400 in meeting cost. One hero button drafts the end-of-week recap.

outro.title: Nine people, all answered
outro.text: Same Friday, same Maya — but the countdown is beaten, the queue is faces served, not forms filed. FoW handles the chasing; Maya makes the calls.
